# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (43) - Minimal Dictation And Local Formatting Beta
## New And Fixed
- Settings now has a Format before pasting switch. When enabled, the installed local Qwen text model formats new dictations before auto-paste, using your saved Text preferences. Previously, preferences affected only manual previews in History. The switch is off by default. - Formatting preserves words and their order while adjusting punctuation, capitalization and paragraphs. The original is saved in History before the model runs and can be restored. If the model is unavailable, fails, or changes words, Mumla uses the original and shows the outcome in Settings. - Choose Recorder or Minimal under Settings > Dictation overlay. Minimal is a small indicator with REC, a live waveform, elapsed time and stop/cancel controls. Neither overlay takes focus from the app you are dictating into. - Formatting is cancellable. Cancelling keeps the saved original and does not paste a late result. Successful auto-paste still dismisses the overlay; existing copy-dialog and silent clipboard fallback settings are respected. - Recording startup no longer repeats the focused-field check or scans the microphone list for every pinned-device recording. The overlay appears with a shorter animation. The 250 ms hold-to-talk shortcut guard remains unchanged; a hardware latency improvement has not yet been measured. - Qwen verifies downloaded files before loading, then reuses the loaded model rather than checking all model files again for every request.
Qwen formatting requires Apple silicon and the separate approximately 3.1 GB model download. It adds processing time, especially on first use. Text preferences control formatting, not rewriting or adding words. Summaries remain separate, explicit previews and are never automatically pasted.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or download the notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Existing history, dictionary, settings and downloaded models are preserved. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies together.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14+, on Apple silicon and Intel. Intel dictation remains supported without Qwen generation. Speech recognition remains Swedish-only; meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented. No cloud fallback. Model and library licenses are available in About.
## Testing
The shared/Mac regression suite completed 269 tests with zero failures and five optional live checks skipped. Both overlay designs were rendered and inspected in light and dark appearances. Synthetic integration tests cover saved prompts, original retention, cancellation, changed focus, clipboard restoration, failed history writes and dismissal after confirmed insertion.
Real microphone-start timing, Swedish model quality, live update installation and cross-app dictation still require target-Mac acceptance. Signing and download verification do not establish those hardware results. iOS/TestFlight is unchanged by this Mac release.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (42) - DJI Mic Button Beta
## New And Fixed
- Optional native DJI Mic Mini button control. Connect the receiver by USB, enable the DJI microphone button in Settings and allow Input Monitoring. A short button press starts hands-free dictation; another press finishes it using Mumla's existing transcription and paste workflow. - The listener ignores other devices, duplicate reports and reported pairing holds. It pauses across sleep and handles receiver disconnection. If the separate DJI Mic Mumla helper is running, quit it before using native control. - The menu-bar icon now matches Mumla's waveform and recording-button branding and follows the system's light/dark menu-bar appearance.
DJI control is off by default. The receiver button does not select the audio input: choose your microphone separately in Settings. Microphone, Secure Input, model readiness and paste protections still apply. Existing keyboard triggers, Qwen formatting and summaries, history, dictionary and appearance remain.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct app, or download the notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies simultaneously. Existing models and local data are preserved.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14+, on Apple silicon and Intel. Optional Qwen text generation is Apple-silicon-only. Speech recognition remains Swedish only; meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented. No cloud transcription fallback. Licenses are available in About.
## Testing
Test short presses, start/stop, receiver disconnect/reconnect and sleep/wake with a real DJI Mic Mini. Check the selected audio input, hotkeys, auto-paste and clipboard restoration in your normal editor. Automated listener tests and signed distribution checks do not establish physical receiver or live updater acceptance. Watch voice notes ship in the separate iOS TestFlight beta.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (41) - Local Qwen and Compact Controls Beta
## New And Fixed
- Optional formatting and summary previews now use Qwen3.5 4B locally through MLX on Apple silicon, without requiring Apple Intelligence or macOS 26. Download the verified 3.1 GB model in Settings before use. It can retain about 3 GB of memory after first use. Intel Macs cannot run this text model. - Add context to a text preview and regenerate it before accepting. Changing context invalidates the old suggestion. Formatting still requires approval; summaries remain separate from the original transcript. Nothing generates automatically in the hotkey path and there is no cloud fallback. - More compact, translucent recorder and transcript controls, with matching light/dark styling and accessible actions. - Recording opens an available pinned microphone directly, without first opening the system-default input. This avoids unnecessarily switching Bluetooth headphone playback into its lower-quality microphone mode when recording from another microphone. An unavailable pinned device still falls back to the system default. Thanks to @ehsanYazdani for [PR #6](https://github.com/simonbromander/Mumla/pull/6).
Includes the existing microphone selection, Secure Input guidance, Chromium paste confirmation, clipboard restoration and optional silent-copy fallback. The Watch voice-notes companion ships in the separate iOS TestFlight beta, not in this Mac download.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct app, or download the notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies simultaneously. Existing dictation models and local data are preserved.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14+, on Apple silicon and Intel. Optional Qwen text generation is Apple-silicon-only. Speech recognition remains Swedish only; meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented. Open-source, model and runtime licenses are available in About.
## Testing
Try the pinned-microphone workflow with Bluetooth headphones, including device disconnect/reconnect. Check auto-paste and clipboard restoration in your real editor. Test model download/cancellation, formatting and summary previews, context changes, acceptance and original restoration. Review generated text carefully: factual and Swedish-language quality remain experimental.
Automated and distribution checks are not physical microphone-routing, hotkey/paste, live updater or general model-quality acceptance.
